definitions.explanation: The record or status of being present or absent, typically in schools or meetings.

examples.japanese: {出欠|しゅっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{出欠|しゅっけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。

⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出欠|しゅっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let us know whether you will attend the meeting by the weekend.

notes:
{出欠|しゅっけつ} combines ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧ (presence) and ⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧ (absence).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take attendance
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: confirmation of attendance
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to inform of attendance status
- {出欠|しゅっけつ}{簿|ぼ}: attendance register

USAGE:
Used in schools, meetings, and events. When responding to invitations, this refers to whether someone will attend or not.
